tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and post background: Paper in light, Ink in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, product tiles, chat bubbles and anything that sits on surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card outlines on surface and surface-raised. Too faint for control borders: use line-strong there.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; at least 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on surface and surface-raised (14:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata, eyebrows and prices on surface and surface-raised (5.6:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and cobalt-coloured text on surface and surface-raised. Dark lightens cobalt so text stays above 4.5:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 2px with a 2px offset; cobalt in light, sun in dark, both above 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: brand-cobalt
tokens.usage: The lead brand colour: profile picture, reverse-logo ground, primary buttons, hero blocks. A fill, not a text colour on dark grounds.

tokens.name: on-cobalt
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a brand-cobalt fill (5:1).

tokens.name: brand-sun
tokens.usage: Accent fill: offers, highlights, campaign tiles, the bottom pill of the reverse stack. Never text or thin lines on a light surface.

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a brand-sun fill (11:1).

tokens.name: brand-coral
tokens.usage: Accent fill: the middle pill of every stack, gift and seasonal tiles. Never text on a light surface (2.5:1).

tokens.name: on-coral
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a brand-coral fill (6.5:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Fixed Paper in both themes: logo pills and wordmark on cobalt or ink, print stock colour.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Fixed Ink in both themes: logo wordmark and top pill on light grounds, one-colour print.

families.arabic: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Space Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Space Grotesk, from Google Fonts. Tight tracking only at display sizes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One hero line per layout: posters, reel covers, the site's first screen.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Campaign lines on feed posts and stories.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section titles, product names on tiles.

styles.name: slogan
styles.usage: The slogan under a logo or at the end of a video.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 3D-printed gifts with your name on them, made in Lebanon.
styles.usage: Running text, captions on the site, product descriptions.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Ready in 3 to 5 days. Order on WhatsApp.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags and section labels, always uppercase.

groups.name: Arabic
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans Arabic, from Google Fonts. Set right to left; keep Ply in Latin letters.

styles.name: arabic-body
styles.sample: هدايا مطبوعة 3D عليها اسمك، معمولة بلبنان.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside tags and between stacked lines of small text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gutter between tiles; padding inside buttons and small cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and post padding; the logo's clear space at feed size.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page or slide.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page margins on desktop and poster margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, product tiles, feed post panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Campaign-line pills and tags. In SVG, draw a pill with rx at half its height instead.
